name: sparsew2t csrc bl_supervised_k_Kfull seed2025
command: set -o pipefail; O=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR; ln -sfn /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/data data; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python -W ignore scripts/run_experiment.py --config configs/baselines/supervised_k.yaml --dataset-config configs/datasets/csrc_pilot.yaml --seeds 2025 --k full --protocols release --override experiment.device=cpu label_budget.n_cal=0.005 eval.save_neg_frac=0.02 --out $O/run 2>&1 | tee $O/run.log | grep -E --line-buffered 'progress|Traceback|Error|saved'; f=$(find $O/run -name rows.csv | head -1); test -n "$f" || { echo 'NO rows.csv'; tail -n 40 $O/run.log; exit 1; }; cp $(dirname $f)/*.csv $O/ && touch $O/DONE
